long_biography.plain_text:
Luke Geelan grew up around Shorco, the equipment-hire business built by his father, Peter, and developed his career across sales, operations and executive management. He later founded Shore Hire, expanding it from a small Sydney operation into a multi-branch national provider of shoring, traffic and building products for construction and infrastructure customers.

After sixteen years of growth, United Rentals acquired Shore Hire. Geelan shifted his attention to the family investment platform he established with Peter. Geelan Property Group now develops and manages commercial, industrial, retail and residential property, alongside land banking, agricultural holdings and selected operating-company stakes. He also remains involved in industry governance as New South Wales president of the Hire and Rental Industry Association.
long_biography.html:
Luke Geelan grew up around Shorco, the equipment-hire business built by his father, Peter, and developed his career across sales, operations and executive management. He later founded Shore Hire, expanding it from a small Sydney operation into a multi-branch national provider of shoring, traffic and building products for construction and infrastructure customers.

After sixteen years of growth, United Rentals acquired Shore Hire. Geelan shifted his attention to the family investment platform he established with Peter. Geelan Property Group now develops and manages commercial, industrial, retail and residential property, alongside land banking, agricultural holdings and selected operating-company stakes. He also remains involved in industry governance as New South Wales president of the Hire and Rental Industry Association.
